mentions.name: fesh
mentions.description: This experiment explores AI-guided compression of executable binaries: fesh acts as a deterministic pre-processor pipeline wrapping LZMA (xz), applying transformations such as extracting near-branches, normalizing jump tables, rewriting .eh_frame DWARF pointers to absolute image bases, delta-encoding ELF .rela structs with ZigZag mappings, and column transpositions before compressing in separate LZMA channels. CI verifies bit-for-bit reversible compression across 103 Alpine Linux x86_64 packages, and benchmarks show payloads averaging ~6% smaller than xz -9e --x86 (XZ BCJ) and consistently smaller than ZSTD and Brotli.
mentions.source_excerpt: The result is an experiment called fesh. It works strictly as a deterministic pre-processor pipeline wrapping LZMA (xz).
